description: The static landing page at /, with no motion yet: build-time data (site-data.ts), the drawings (KeypadPicture, Pictures), the header, ten sections and footer as server components with content.md copy word for word, the rewritten site.css (phone, tablet, desktop layouts, R2 bar order, R3 link targets, R5 labels, R6 hero padding), and the unit tests site-data, site, site-css (static cases). Depends on FEAT-001 (the page lives at app/page.tsx and the app at /app).
steps: Plan step 10: rewrite packages/web/components/site/site-data.ts per design.md 'Build-time data' (readJson with candidate paths, getDemoData unchanged algorithm, getHowData, getProofExample that throws, getResults(read = readJson) with validation and modelRuns from RESULTS.llm.json using isModelId and MODEL_PROFILES from '@ninth/decoder', modelRunsLine, ISSUES_URL, NOTICE_URL; modelNotRun removed); drop the modelNotRun clause in the interim app/page.tsx; new test/site-data.test.ts (fixture in the real RESULTS.llm.json shape; one test on the real file expects { sizes: [200], count: 2 }).

Plan step 11: new components/site/KeypadPicture.tsx (KEY_DRAWING_SIZE '64px', HERO_KEY_SIZE 'clamp(64px, calc((100vw - 120px) / 3), 84px)', inline --nl-key on div.nl-keypad.site-pad aria-hidden, div.nl-key.site-key from KEY_ROWS, is-pressed, site-key--ninth) and components/site/Pictures.tsx (HowFrames 3, ProofFrames 3, ScanFrames 4, ShowFrames 2, SaidBubble, RankingSwitch, OfflineChip) per design.md §2-§6 and 'Drawings'; frame labels label size 16px (R5).

Plan step 12: new components/site/SiteHeader.tsx (bar DOM order brand, nav, CTA; hero with KeypadDemo), components/site/sections/{How,Proof,Conversation,Access,Privacy,Results,Limits,Faq,Source,Start}.tsx, components/site/SiteFooter.tsx; rewrite app/page.tsx (force-static, metadata with openGraph and twitter from content.md, structure of design 'Page structure and layout'); data-reveal exactly on the A4 blocks with --reveal-i 0,1,2,2; KeypadDemo uses <KeypadPicture size={HERO_KEY_SIZE} pressed={playing ? s.key : undefined} ninth /> and sets is-playing on .site-demo while playing.

Plan step 13: rewrite components/site/site.css for the new markup (static only): no `order` property anywhere (R2), standalone link rule and gap var(--space-2) var(--space-6) (R3), footer on tokens (R3), hero paddings (R6), short-landscape rule last, .site-key ring ::after, .site-key cursor/active resets, .site-frames base stack with `.site-frames > :not(:last-child) { opacity: 0 }` outside any at-rule, safe-area side padding with env(safe-area-inset-left/right), tokens only, no ember background, no --nl-key, no .site-demo__pad.

Plan step 14: new test/site.test.tsx (design.md Test plan site.test.tsx cases, copy check with R1, banned-claims regex, MS-4.3 tm-lint spawn + word list from scripts/tm-lint.mjs + brand regex, MS-9.3, MS-10.8, MS-8.4 no nesting, MS-11.3 imports, MS-4.4-4.8, MS-5.1, MS-5.4, MS-6.1, MS-6.2, MS-7.1, MS-7.2, MS-7.4, MS-13.3); new test/site-css.test.ts static cases (MS-7.2, MS-7.3/MS-9.1, MS-7.5, MS-9.2, MS-10.1, MS-3.3/MS-10.7, MS-10.5/MS-10.8, no `order:`); add MS-10.6 to test/routes.test.ts.

Plan step 15: typecheck, web tests, tm-lint on components/site/**, app/page.tsx and the new tests; dev-server check then BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/axe.mjs; look at / at 360, 820 and 1280 wide (Playwright MCP); KIRO_LOG row; tick tasks 10-13.1 in tasks.md.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run` passes including site-data.test.ts, site.test.tsx, site-css.test.ts and routes.test.ts MS-10.6
GET http://localhost:3000/ answers 200 with one h1 'Ninth Life' and sections how, proof, conversation, access, privacy, results, limits, faq, source, start in that order
axe.mjs passes against the dev server, including 'landing /'
node scripts/tm-lint.mjs is clean on every file under packages/web/components/site/, app/page.tsx and the new tests
verification: node scripts/tm-lint.mjs packages/web/components/site/*.ts* packages/web/components/site/sections/*.tsx packages/web/components/site/site.css packages/web/app/page.tsx packages/web/test/site*.ts*
findings: Verification (this checkout, dev server on :3000, nothing committed): pnpm -r typecheck pass; pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run pass (27 files, 277 tests; new site.test.tsx 31, site-data.test.ts 13, site-css.test.ts 9, routes.test.ts now 12 with MS-10.6); tm-lint clean on the 22 files of the verification glob plus routes.test.ts, tasks.md, KIRO_LOG.md; curl /app 200 and / 200; BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/axe.mjs 'all checks passed' (landing / 0 violations, 29 rules passed, Night+Day, 1280+390), run again after the last CSS edit, same result. Looked at / with the Playwright MCP: 360x668 no sideways scroll, bar 80px (one row), h1 bottom 232, hero CTA bottom 600 (design estimate 634), keys 64-80px; 820x1094 bar wraps in DOM order to 144px (brand + nav on row 1, header CTA alone at the left of row 2), keys 64-84; 1280x900 one-row bar, hero two columns, How picture 460 wide sticky beside 3 steps, proof copy 724 + figure 380 side by side, conversation 2 columns, access 3+2 cards of 368px; no console errors, no hydration warnings. Deviations and notes for later steps: (1) readJson returns undefined when no candidate file exists and null when a file exists but does not parse, so getResults can warn on an unparsable RESULTS.llm.json but not on a missing one (design error table); getResults(read) takes a JsonReader with that contract. Missing lexicon logs one '[site] the lexicon is missing...' warning. (2) site-data.ts also exports sentenceCase() and finishedSentence(demo) (the Show drawing's sentence); KeypadDemo keeps its own sentenceCase because a client module cannot import the node:fs module. (3) KeypadDemo in this step: KeypadPicture (HERO_KEY_SIZE, pressed while playing, ninth always), is-playing on .site-demo, and the visually hidden caption from content.md §1 added now (the MS-4.1 copy check needs it); the button still reads 'Play the example again' on first render (old done logic) - step 19 changes labels, timers, Hear it, sizers. (4) The MS-4.1 copy check also skips the §1 live-region string 'Typed {codes}. Ninth Life shows: {sentence}.' (empty until a person's play; covered later by keypad-demo.test MS-6.6), in addition to the design's removals. (5) The ninth-key rule '.site-demo.is-playing .site-key--ninth:not(.is-pressed)::after { visibility: hidden; }' is already in the static part of site.css (design 'Drawings' shows it there; it is not an animation); step 18 should not add it again. No animation, transition or animation-timeline declaration exists in site.css yet. (6) Drawing hooks for later tests/CSS: every drawing root has .site-drawing (except ProofFrames, whose root is .site-frames.site-frames--proof); frame stacks are .site-frames--how (3), --proof (3), --scan (4), --show (2); frames carry site-frame--KofN; the scan overlays sit in .site-frames--scan, an absolute grid over the keypad with the keypad's own padding and gaps (rows 1-3 and key 9 by grid-area). .site-frame aligns to the bottom (justify-content: flex-end) so the drawn keypad stays put across How frames; proof frames align to the top. (7) Bands alternate: how ground, proof surface, conversation ground, access surface, privacy ground, results surface, limits ground, faq surface, source ground, start surface. How desktop grid is picture left (5fr) and steps right (7fr), in DOM order. (8) site.test MS-3.2 filters <script> out of .site's children, so the boot script of step 17 does not break it; MS-11.3 already allows SiteMotion.tsx. MS-10.8 test reads pad.style.getPropertyValue('--nl-key') (jsdom keeps custom properties) and expects 5 pads (hero, 3 How frames, scan). (9) Shell: commands run via nohup with logs in /tmp (the tool times out even when commands finish); a full web test run takes about 3 s of test time once started. (10) At 64px keys the design system's corner digit (16px at top 9px left 12px) touches the letters of some keys (for example 8 TUV); that is the design system's Key at the MS-10.5 minimum, not changed here. (11) KIRO_LOG row added (2026-11-10, 'Kiro (marketing-landing workflow, FEAT-002)'); tasks 10, 10.1, 11, 12, 13, 13.1 ticked in tasks.md (12 and 13.1 note that the boot script and its MS-8.1 case land with task 14).
